project.name: Elocutio
project.description: A private, open-source, bring-your-own-key writing assistant for macOS. Local Harper rules for instant correctness; your chosen model for judgment; a local voice profile that learns how you write.

milestones.name: Planning & foundation
milestones.outcome: Audit, plan, architecture, feature matrix, decisions, prompt library, voice design, brand system, and a compiling repository scaffold.

tasks.title: Product, competitor, and market audit
Build plan: strategy, scope, phase gates, estimates
Architecture: process model, data types, IPC, platform strategy
Brand system, palette, and generated platform icons
Repository scaffold: Rust workspace, crates, CI, governance

acceptance.text: Audit, plan, and architecture are approved and committed
Rust workspace compiles and the CI workflow is in place
Brand system and platform icons are generated from source art

milestones.name: Fork, rebrand, spike
milestones.outcome: Rebranded app builds and runs; overlay works in five apps; an OpenRouter key validates; a minimal LLM rewrite replaces a selection.

tasks.title: Fork Harper v2.13.0, add the upstream remote, write UPSTREAM.md
tasks.notes: Fork documentation, base lock, and upstream remote are in place; the source checkout is local-only.

tasks.title: Rebrand product name, bundle ID, icons, tray, config paths, updater keys, and About
tasks.notes: Product name, bundle ID, generated icons, tray, window copy, issue URL, config path, and About/issue surfaces are rebranded. The updater was removed for M0 and returns in M5 with our own keypair.

tasks.title: Build and run on macOS; verify the AX overlay in TextEdit, Notes, Mail, Safari, and Chrome
tasks.notes: Builds and launches. TextEdit, Notes, and Safari pass the overlay; Chrome and Mail are excluded from AX probing for M0 stability (Chrome needs the M3 extension, Mail needs a text-bounds fallback). Rewrite Selection works in TextEdit, Safari, and Chrome. The app support matrix is tracked in apps/macos/src-tauri/src/app_matrix.json and a test keeps it in step with the Rust allowlist. The five-app gate is the only part of M0 still open.

tasks.title: Add the elocutio-llm skeleton: OpenRouter client, Keychain, model catalog, key validation
tasks.notes: OpenRouter key validation, Keychain storage, and an in-app rewrite are implemented in apps/macos/src-tauri/src/openrouter.rs. The full provider router and model catalog remain M1.

tasks.title: Prove the end-to-end path: rewrite the selection with AI through the write ladder
tasks.notes: System-wide Rewrite Selection works via ⌥⌘E or the tray menu using a transient/concealed pasteboard string, ⌘V, read-back verification, and text clipboard restore in TextEdit, Safari, and Chrome. The overlay uses the AX fast path for local lints.

tasks.title: Decide IPC ownership and document the main ↔ highlighter protocol
tasks.notes: Decided: the main process owns secrets and network, the highlighter owns text and injection. Protocol framing, messages, and failure handling are documented.

tasks.title: Security audit of inherited network, IPC, updater, and permission surfaces
tasks.notes: The inherited code has been reviewed: network surface, IPC, updater, permissions, storage, text injection, and prompt injection. The review fixed three high-severity write-path defects (clipboard data loss, a paste read-back that accepted a corrupted result, and a default request the default model rejected with a 400) and left one medium finding open for the M3 browser bridge: the IPC protocol has no frame-size limit or version envelope yet. See docs/SECURITY-REVIEW.md.

acceptance.text: Rebranded app builds and launches on macOS
Overlay works in TextEdit, Notes, Mail, Safari, and Chrome
OpenRouter key validates and is stored in the Keychain
A rewrite replaces the selection correctly via pasteboard + ⌘V, with AX fast path where settable
The suggestion card never steals focus
No Harper branding, bundle IDs, URLs, or config paths remain

milestones.name: LLM MVP
milestones.outcome: Local and LLM suggestions in the focused field, a suggestion card with accept/dismiss, tone detection, onboarding, Keychain storage, and a usage log.

tasks.title: Provider abstraction with OpenRouter and OpenAI-compatible adapters; streaming, retries, error taxonomy
tasks.notes: OpenRouter and OpenAI-compatible adapters share one canonical request type. The error taxonomy (13 kinds) is live code, the model catalog is a local curated table, the SSE stream decoder is tested, and the default model no longer sends a temperature the Claude 5 family rejects. Streaming is implemented and tested but not yet wired to a command.

tasks.title: Chunking, prompt v1, JSON schema, validation, offset resolver, and dedupe
tasks.notes: Paragraph chunking, prompt p1, JSON schema s1, payload validation, exact/normalized/fuzzy span resolution, dedupe, and rejected-edit reporting are implemented in elocutio-analysis with 18 tests and wired to an in-app Analyze card.

tasks.title: Merge local and LLM suggestions; rank by confidence, severity, and category
tasks.notes: Local lints take precedence on overlapping spans; LLM suggestions fill gaps. The merged list is sorted by screen position and severity (high before medium before low).

tasks.title: Suggestion card UI: accept, dismiss, explain; inherited local underlines; LLM suggestions in the card
tasks.notes: The inherited card renders local + cached LLM suggestions with accept/dismiss/explain. A compact white widget on every supported focused field shows the count, opens the card, and triggers analysis via an AI action over IPC.

tasks.title: Onboarding: local-only vs provider, key, model, permissions, and playground
tasks.notes: Onboarding checklist checks Accessibility, Keychain provider key, and ⌥⌘E; completion persists so setup opens once.

tasks.title: Settings: providers and models, per-app enablement, privacy, and usage
tasks.notes: Settings covers provider choice, key status, model, tone, usage, onboarding, auto-analysis, per-app enablement, auto-enable new apps, budget warning, local-only mode, and undo. Deeper privacy controls remain.

tasks.title: Keychain storage, cost log, and budget warnings
tasks.notes: Provider key lives in Keychain; usage log records metadata only; Settings supports an optional USD budget warning from the log.

tasks.title: Record accept, dismiss, and edit-after-accept events locally (opt-in) for voice v0
tasks.notes: Suggestion events are recorded locally: rule, category, and edit size, never the text. The log is opt-in, bounded, and deletable from Settings.

tasks.title: Golden-set harness v0: false-positive rate and span-accuracy metrics
tasks.notes: A golden-set harness with span precision/recall/F0.5, exact-match, over-edit, schema-failure, and resolution metrics, plus the plan's regression gate. The seed set has 44 items with 8 no-error controls; the plan wants 200-500, so the data still needs to grow.

tasks.title: M1 gate: five-app end-to-end run (pasteboard, read-back, undo, offline/402 states, key restart)
tasks.notes: The gate is a runnable report: every check the plan lists is either proved by the repository or marked as needing a human. The five-app overlay check fails today, because Chrome and Mail are not drawn in yet, and the gate says so rather than reporting green. The clipboard, read-back, error-state, log-content, key, undo, and probe-safety checks pass. The write-ladder check needs a human in each app.

acceptance.text: In five apps, including a Chromium-based app, a shortcut produces suggestions
Accept edits the correct span via pasteboard or the AppKit AX fast path; read-back verification passes
Undo works after an accepted suggestion
Invalid key, offline, and 402 states are clear and actionable
Zero user text in logs
The API key survives an app restart

milestones.name: Inline UX + Voice v0
milestones.outcome: Grammarly-style widget, live LLM mode, tone and paragraph rewrites with diffs, cache and cost caps, a hardened 10-app matrix, and a voice profile learned from feedback.

tasks.title: Grammarly-style widget: count, tone, anchors, and per-app positioning
tasks.notes: The floating widget shows the live count, opens the inherited card, triggers AI analysis, and anchors to the first underline or the screen corner. Per-app positioning, a tone badge, and drag behavior remain.

tasks.title: Live LLM mode: debounce, diff-only requests, cancel, stale guard, and throttles
tasks.notes: The live watcher debounces, deduplicates, throttles per app, sends only the changed paragraphs, and discards a result that was superseded while the request was in flight.

tasks.title: Tone detection, tone rewrite presets, and custom instructions
tasks.notes: Tone detection is local, deterministic, and explainable: it measures contractions, hedges, intensifiers, pronouns, imperatives, passive voice, and sentence length, and shows the evidence behind the label. Tone presets feed the provider prompt, and a custom instruction can be applied to every request; it is sanitized so it cannot fake a prompt boundary.

tasks.title: Paragraph rewrite with word-level diff and accept/reject
tasks.notes: The word-level diff renders in Settings after a rewrite. The system-wide path still replaces the selection immediately, without a preview to accept or reject.

tasks.title: Cache, request coalescing, and cost caps
tasks.notes: The suggestion cache is keyed by text hash with a 24-hour time to live, a per-request cost cap refuses a request before it is sent, and a coalescer gives one request to two callers asking the same question and throttles a burst for the same key.

tasks.title: Secure-field and blocklist hardening
tasks.notes: Secure input and secure text fields are refused, and a block list stops an app from being read or sent to a provider even when it is enabled as an integration.

tasks.title: Tier A matrix: 10 apps across light/dark, multi-monitor, Spaces, and full-screen
Voice v0: learn traits with confidence from accepted, dismissed, and edited suggestions
tasks.notes: The style card holds 12 aggregate traits plus 8-gram sample fingerprints, so the copy guard works without storing raw samples. Feedback covers accepted, dismissed, and edited-after-accept edits, weighted with a 180-day half-life and down-weighting model-authored text.

tasks.title: Voice v0: style card in rewrites, trait overrides, "sounds like me" rating, and settings tab
tasks.notes: The style card is injected into rewrite and analysis prompts, and a copy guard refuses output that repeats the writer's samples. The user can rate a rewrite, override any trait by hand, and clear an override to restore the learned value.

acceptance.text: The widget never activates the host app
Underlines align within ±2 pt
Live-mode p95 latency stays under 4 s
Widget position persists when the host window moves
No request storms: coalescing and stale-result guards hold under fast typing
acceptance.notes: The live watcher debounces, dedupes by text hash, throttles per app at 20 seconds, sends only the changed paragraphs, and discards a result that a newer request superseded. A coalescer gives one request to two callers asking the same question.

acceptance.text: After five accepted or edited suggestions, the profile shows at least three learned traits with confidence and applies to a rewrite
acceptance.notes: Feedback learning produces eight traits with a confidence and an evidence string, and the prompt guidance reads the learned traits, so the profile is applied to a rewrite. The traits are: accepted_edits, dismissed_edits, edited_after_accept, accepted_categories, dismissed_categories, prefers_contractions, prefers_concise, and the inferred term preferences.

acceptance.text: The elocutio-voice copy guard passes
acceptance.notes: The copy guard compares the provider's output against the 8-gram fingerprints of the writer's samples and refuses the rewrite on an overlap. It is applied inside the rewrite function, so every rewrite path fails closed.

risks.mitigation: Pin v2.13.0, audit the inherited surface, add tests, keep upstream sync, be ready to patch.
Custom design system, native overlay windows, small webviews only for settings and panels.
Reuse Harper geometry, add golden screenshots, keep a widget-first fallback.
Re-read before injecting; pasteboard + ⌘V primary; read-back verify; abort on mismatch; undo; never touch secure fields.
Instant local rules, debounced or on-demand LLM, caching, a cheap default model, and budget caps.
Quote-based schema, local resolution, ambiguity rejection, and a repair loop.
Keychain only in the main process, redaction, and no keys in highlighter logs.
127.0.0.1 only, pairing token, Origin allowlist, and close on quit.
Small isolated patches, contribute generic fixes upstream, quarterly base review.
Phase gates, explicit non-goals, and the deferred list are enforced at each milestone.
